title: Implement User Registration API
description: Develop the API endpoint for user registration as defined in the OpenAPI specification.
acceptance_criteria: Successful registration creates a new user record in the database.
The API returns a 201 Created status code upon successful registration.
Invalid input data (e.g., missing fields, invalid email format) results in a 400 Bad Request error.
Password hashing is applied before storing the password in the database.
tdd_contract:
def test_user_registration_success():
    response = client.post('/users/register', json={'username': 'testuser', 'email': 'test@example.com', 'password': 'password123'})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    # Verify user exists in the database

title: Implement User Login API
description: Develop the API endpoint for user login and authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Successful login returns a valid JWT token.
The API returns a 200 OK status code upon successful login.
Invalid credentials result in a 401 Unauthorized error.
JWT token includes necessary user information (e.g., user ID, username).
tdd_contract:
def test_user_login_success():
    response = client.post('/auth/login', json={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'password123'})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    token = response.json()
    assert isinstance(token, str)

title: Implement Flight Search API
description: Develop the API endpoint to search for flights based on specified criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The API returns a list of flights matching the search criteria.
Flights are filtered by origin, destination, and departure date.
Optional parameters (passengers, class) can be used to further refine the results.
The API handles invalid or missing input data gracefully.
tdd_contract:
def test_flight_search_success():
    response = client.get('/flights/search?origin=JFK&destination=LAX&departureDate=2024-12-25')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    results = response.json()
    assert isinstance(results, list)

title: Implement Hotel Search API
description: Develop the API endpoint to search for hotels based on specified criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The API returns a list of hotels matching the search criteria.
Hotels are filtered by destination, check-in date, and check-out date.
Optional parameter (guests) can be used to refine results
API handles invalid or missing input data.
tdd_contract:
def test_hotel_search_success():
    response = client.get('/hotels/search?destination=New York&checkInDate=2024-12-25&checkOutDate=2024-12-30')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    results = response.json()
    assert isinstance(results, list)

title: Implement Frontend Flight Search Component
description: Develop the React component for searching flights, including input fields and display of search results.
acceptance_criteria: The component displays appropriate input fields for origin, destination, departure date, passengers, and class.
User input is validated before submitting the search request.
Search results are displayed in a clear and organized manner.
Component handles loading state while waiting for API response.
